zoe_fin: Heads up - vendor_bluewave invoice BW-2025-07 (07 Jul 2025) came in. Invoice company name = "BlueWave Inc." but W-9 we have on file is for "BlueWave LLC". Bank account name for ACH is "BlueWave LLC" too. Holding payment until we reconcile name mismatch.

ethan_ops: @zoe_fin can you attach the invoice and the W-9? I'll ping the vendor. We need name alignment for 1099 and ACH. :mag: 

vendor_bluewave: Sorry about that - our accounting team used old stationery. Invoice PDF: https://files.vendor/bluewave-invoice-BW-2025-07.pdf. W-9 we submitted last month is signed and shows EIN 12-3456789 under BlueWave LLC. We can reissue invoice to BlueWave LLC or provide a signed DBA declaration.

zoe_fin: Thanks. Finance policy: invoice payee name must match W-9 name for US suppliers for 1099 reporting. If they use a DBA, we need a signed statement linking the DBA to the legal entity (EIN). Otherwise require reissued invoice. Also bank account name should match W-9 for ACH - otherwise we escalate to payments for manual review.

vendor_bluewave: Understood. We'll reissue invoice to BlueWave LLC. One question: will a simple emailed attestation from our CEO linking the names suffice or do you need notarized docs?

tax_bot: Attestation is ok for AP processing, but keep a copy in the vendor file. For 1099s, the payer needs the correct legal name and TIN (W-9). If the name on the return doesn't match IRS records, IRS may send CP2100 notices. Best practice: reissued invoice + W-9 on file.

ethan_ops: Notarized docs not required here. Reissue invoice PDF to BlueWave LLC and confirm bank account name (same as W-9). Send both to invoice@redwood.com.

vendor_bluewave: Reissued invoice sent and attached to portal. Bank account name confirmed as BlueWave LLC. Also attached signed W-9 again.

zoe_fin: Received reissue + W-9. Payments: will release on next cycle. For posterity, finance will note that prior invoice had a trade name mismatch. If future 1099 mismatch notices arrive, vendor will need to work with us to resolve.

payments_bot: Hold cleared for BW-2025-07. Payment scheduled for next run.

zoe_fin: Resolving thread. :white_check_mark:
